limitations: The workload is the deterministic synthetic Helix CPU demo, not production traffic.
A negative overhead estimate inside the measured noise floor is not a speedup claim.
Resource sampling is periodic and can miss peaks between 100 ms samples.
The timed path includes the same raw plus canonical Pydantic adaptation and bounded in-memory buffer as the vertical runner, but excludes post-run JSONL, Perfetto, and Parquet serialization.

metric_availability.branch_readiness_ns: UNKNOWN: the lifecycle wrapper reports one inclusive combined model-and-environment branch-group fork span, not per-branch readiness
metric_availability.combined_branch_group_fork_span_ns: AVAILABLE for minimal/full; disabled mode has no lifecycle wrappers
metric_availability.cpu_utilization: AVAILABLE as process CPU time divided by wall time
metric_availability.gpu_utilization: UNAVAILABLE: no compatible GPU execution occurred
metric_availability.learning_transaction_latency: AVAILABLE as full run wall time
metric_availability.memory: AVAILABLE as 100 ms sampled process RSS/VMS with identical full resource sampling apparatus across trace levels
metric_availability.per_token_latency_ns: UNAVAILABLE: fixture emits policy decisions, not model-server token timings
metric_availability.rollout_throughput: NOT COMPARABLE ACROSS LEVELS: disabled mode has no lifecycle wrappers
metric_availability.storage_writes: AVAILABLE as persisted canonical JSONL/Perfetto bytes; process I/O is retained only where psutil supports it
metric_availability.ttft_ns: UNAVAILABLE: reference CPU policy demo has no model-server TTFT
